messages:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a small variance sweep for the streaming + tool-call + structured-output path? Seeing some noisy p50/p99 in prod last night and want to rule out API-layer serialization as the culprit.

josh: I can take this today. any particular model / payload shape you want?

maria: thanks. start with rdx-large (q4f16) and rdx-medium (q8_0), seq len ~1024, toolcall payloads with nested args (list of dicts), and structured output enabled (JSON schema).

akshay: noting that the incident report showed spike correlated with heavy concurrent toolcalls (50-100 inflight). suggest testing at 1, 10, 50 concurrency levels.

sam: +1 on conc levels. Also add a cold-start run (empty runtime cache) vs warm to see KV-cache effect.

josh: got it. I'll run local microbench then a CI job. what sample size? 200 runs per config?

maria: 200 sounds fine for p95 stability. CI can be 50 if it's slow. capture full latency histogram + stdout serialization time.

akshay: small tip: instrument by exporting these fields from the runtime trace: kernel_ms, kvcache_ms, serialize_ms, stream_flush_ms. that helps isolate serialization vs runtime.

maria: perfect — include the raw traces and a summary csv. can you post perf dashboards links when done?

ci-bot: build/bench-run triggered by josh at 1898765520. Job: bench/stream-toolcall/variant-sweep.

josh: local smoke looks ok, but rdx-large q4f16 has a weird 15-20ms bump in serialize_ms when structured output enabled. attaching minimal repro below:
```
# repro client snippet
resp = client.generate_stream(model="rdx-large", input=payload, streaming=True, structured_schema=SCHEMA)
for chunk in resp:
    process(chunk)
```

sam: can you paste a small example of the nested args that reproduce? might be related to recursion in the serializer.

josh: example payload (sanitized): {"actions": [{"type": "search", "params": {"q": "X", "filters": [{"k": "t", "v": "1"}]}} for _ in range(3)]}

akshay: hm that nested list-of-dicts pattern triggers extra safe-json paths in our serialize code. we added an optimization in PR #482 to flatten small dicts but it was gated. might be regressed.

maria: file PR link if you find it. also if perf-bot CI runs are complete, can you paste p50/p95 for both models and conc levels?

perf-bot: bench job completed at 1898765665. Artifacts: gs://redwood-perf/bench/1898765520/ (summary.csv, traces.tar.gz, html-dashboard).

josh: results summary (local + CI):
- rdx-medium q8_0: conc 1 p50 32ms p95 78ms serialize_ms median 4ms
- rdx-medium q8_0: conc 50 p50 48ms p95 210ms serialize_ms median 6ms
- rdx-large q4f16: conc 1 p50 45ms p95 95ms serialize_ms median 18ms (structured on)
- rdx-large q4f16: conc 50 p50 90ms p95 410ms serialize_ms median 22ms (structured on)

sam: those serialize medians for rdx-large look suspicious. can we rerun with the optimization branch (PR #482) toggled on? akshay can you enable it in a local build?

akshay: yes I can try. that optimization avoided deepcopy for small dicts. will run a quick compare.

akshay: quick compare results: enable-opt vs disable-opt for rdx-large conc 1: serialize_ms median 7ms vs 18ms. huge win. p95 also improved ~2x.

maria: lovely. next steps: akshay open a small revert/patch to re-enable the opt but add a safety test for edge case we found. josh please add a CI bench job to run this sweep nightly for 7 days (low sample) and alert if serialize_ms regresses >20% over baseline.

josh: will do. created ticket PERF-874 and added the nightly job link in comments.

maria: thanks team. anyone want on-call handoff notes for prod config change? we'll rollout opt to canary first (10% traffic) then 100% if stable for 6 hours.

sam: I'll own the canary rollout and watch metrics. ping me when opt is in canary. :eyes:

maria: thanks — closing thread once PR and ticket are up. :thumbsup:
